rows.en: Don't be stupid! We're up against Destron! Go!
Wait! I'll defeat Marshal Armor with my own power!
Don't be stupid!?
Kazami, today I'll send you to hell!
Damn… Shiro Kazami, no, Kamen Rider V3! Just you wait!
Shiro Kazami, no, Kamen Rider V3! This time, I'll put you to sleep with my Hypno TV! Flyyy, flyyy…
My Hypno TV doesn't work!? That's impossible… Nuooooh!
Riders 1 and 2 poured all their strength into remodeling me… It has to be there! A hidden power, in me too!
Riders 1 and 2 poured all their strength into remodeling me… It has to be there! A hidden power, in me too!

Even I don't fully grasp Rider V3's abilities!

Surely, surely… there must be a power that surpasses Destron's cyborgs!

Even I don't fully grasp Rider V3's abilities!

Surely, surely… there must be a power that surpasses Destron's cyborgs!
Are you all right? Riderman, no, Yuki…
Damn… Marshal Armor was right in front of me and I let him get away. What a waste…
Wait! Where are you going? Yukiii!!
What an unfriendly man, isn't he?
Kinda rude, huh…

Someday… he'll understand, I'm sure of it!

For that… we have to fight even harder for justice!

When he sees us do that, he'll realize… there's something bigger than personal revenge. And who the real "enemy" is…
Defeat all Destron Combatants!
Defeat TV-Fly and all Destron Combatants!
Defeat TV-Fly!
Defeat Kamebazooka and all Destron Combatants!
Joji Yuki is defeated
Shiro Kazami or Joji Yuki is defeated

Hello, Amigo… Eh? Uh-huh… yes…

Hey, Goro… It's for you!
Hello, Watari speaking…!?
Neo-Humans!? …A proposal?
Are you Neo-Humans too?
Wait!! I'll hear your business right here… What's this proposal?
Emperor Banba… You're the one who called me here?
I have a proposal to make to you, in confidence…
Hoh? The devil emperor has a proposal for me…
Goro Watari… no, Inazuman. What do you say, will you join forces with me?
Join forces? With you?

Indeed… If you and I join forces, we'll be truly invincible!

There'll be nothing left in this world to fear… What do you say? Will you take my hand?
Give me a break!
No, it's no joke! I mean it from the bottom of my heart…

Then I'll say it plainly!

My mission… is to fight you and defeat you! Don't you forget it!
If you won't become my partner… the Japanese archipelago will sink! Are you fine with that?
Japan… will sink…?
Well? Goro Watari…
Lord Emperor Banba… So this is where you were?
Hm? I told you not to follow me! Go back!!
We have no need of your orders.
What!? Ooh!!
You lot!?
Fufufu…
You… What is the meaning of this?
A psychic-power nullifying ring. Even you, the Emperor, are as good as powerless once this is on you…
Curse you… Have you betrayed me too?
Banba… Now I understand why you wanted to join forces.
Fufufu…
…!? You're the ringleader?
No questions! More to the point, we'll now carry out your executions! Step forward!!

If you're going to kill me, then kill me! The Japanese archipelago will sink to the bottom of the sea soon anyway…

Fuhahahaha… You'll all be coming to hell with me!
Fufufu… Do you think I'd fall for a threat like that?

Fool…

I've planted a crustal deformation device in an active fault 3,000 meters underground, in a certain volcanic belt!
A crustal deformation device?
Give it a good shake with an earthquake, and this long, thin Japanese archipelago won't stand a chance!

"Emperor Banba… really does seem to have planted a crustal deformation device. I have to do something…

But… if I make a careless move, they'll riddle me with bullets before I can become Inazuman!! What on earth should I do?

In that case… I have no choice but to use all my energy! Zeber, a new power…"

Never mind! Carry out the execution! We now begin the firing squad!

First… Goro Watari!! Do it!!
Damn! If only this thing weren't on me…
Hmph…
Warrior of freedom, [VAR6]!!
Curse you, [VAR6]! How dare you interfere… Damn!
Who on earth are you?
Fufufu… You'll find out soon enough! Remember this!!

Wait!!

Kuh… He got away? A tough one!
[VAR6]… Do something about this! I can't move freely!
If I free you… will you tell me where the crustal deformation device is?
What!?
If you won't, fine…
No, wait! I'll tell you…
You mean it?
Fuhahahahaha… Goro Watari, you fell right for it!
Banba… You tricked me? I won't forgive you!

I want power… I want the Emperor's throne! And for that, I must defeat you!

I will carry out my final grand plan!
…!? Has the crustal deformation device been activated?
